freeze_policy.bounded_extension: factor 9 added only after preserved v1 factor-7 candidate missed the frozen spot-width gate

optical_gate.rationale: unchanged from v1: 0.0012 detector pixel corresponds to 0.5 nm across one lenslet; final reconstructed-wavefront tests enforce both original tolerances

candidate_calibration.reference_convention: single noiseless integer flat frame; exact thresholded quotient rounded to signed Q18
candidate_calibration.interaction_convention: exact thresholded integer-frame centroids from independent +/- mode probes
candidate_calibration.primary_policy: one frozen factor-8 calibration applied at factors 8 and 9

noisy_confirmation.coupling: pair-local shared-minimum Poisson plus shared Gaussian read noise
noisy_confirmation.expected_difference_estimator: mean of cross-products between independent batch-mean coefficient differences; unbiased for squared expected-reconstruction difference

acceptance.equivalence_margin_nm: min(0.5, 0.05 * factor-9 reference mean residual in nm)
acceptance.deterministic_case_rule: both reconstructed-wavefront RMS change and absolute residual change are <= the equivalence margin; factor 9 is never credited for self-agreement
acceptance.noisy_residual_rule: paired Student-t interval across independent wavefronts lies wholly inside +/- equivalence margin
acceptance.noisy_expected_reconstruction_rule: upper Student-t interval for the independent-cross-batch squared estimator is <= equivalence_margin_nm squared
acceptance.noisy_deterministic_rule: upper Student-t interval for exact deterministic integer-frame reconstruction difference is <= equivalence margin
acceptance.noisy_cell_rule: residual, expected-reconstruction, and deterministic rules all pass
